English.Char_Desc_2000:
SWEEPR Cleaner (by Benjamin Cook t/a SWEEPR Cleaner) is a fast, lightweight Windows 10/11 PC cleaner built in Rust & Tauri—zero popup ads or bundled junkware.
Key Features: - Fast & Lightweight (6.76 MB): Native Rust installer with Zero-Telemetry Offline Mode enabled by default and optional tray / Task Scheduler cleaning. - SWEEPR Free & Pro Deep Cleanup: SWEEPR Free: Unlimited Temp & Browser Cache Clean (to OS Recycle Bin) for Chrome, Edge, Firefox & Brave; Pro unlocks Deep GPU/AI/Dev Caches, Chat Apps, SHA-256 Duplicates, Uninstaller, Scheduler & 7-Day Undo Quarantine. - 7-Day Undo Quarantine (configurable 2–10 GB disk budget, 5 GB default, same-volume O(1) move; OS Recycle Bin fallback; excludes shredded files, browser DBs, and registry edits). - Speed & Startup Booster: 1-click Gaming Mode, startup manager, memory optimization, and Explorer context-menu cleanup. - Complete App Uninstaller & Updater: Drag-and-drop removal of apps and hidden leftovers, broken shortcut repair, and 1-click app updates. - SHA-256 Duplicate & Large File Mover: Finds exact duplicate files and photos, maps disk usage, and moves oversized files across drives. - Privacy & File Shredder: Clears tracking cookies without logging you out, checks passwords locally via k-anonymity SHA-1 prefix (never sending passwords), and includes a best-effort 3-pass file shredder (earlier copies may survive on SSDs with TRIM/wear-leveling).
